manifest.description: Duplicate row for one property (identical property_id appears twice).
Inconsistent property type label: one row says 'Ind'l' instead of 'Industrial'.
Different date format in observation_date for one row (string '03/31/2024' vs ISO).
Stale observation_date for one row (2023-12-31 instead of 2024-03-31).
Extreme but potentially legitimate outlier: one property's asking_price is 3x the peer median.
Leakage field available only after the decision date: future_market_cap_rate_observed_q2_2026 present for all rows.
manifest.point_in_time_note: This field is sourced from Q2 2026 CBRE data, available after 2024-03-31. Using it for a 2024-03-31 decision is leakage.

note: The application intentionally does not auto-clean these issues. Students must identify and handle them.
